# Wayfair

> Wayfair is a leading online home goods marketplace connecting merchants and vendors with customers through a comprehensive seller platform and product optimization tools.

Wayfair operates a vendor-centric marketplace for furniture and home goods, featuring merchant onboarding, seller tools, and administrative systems powered by authentication infrastructure like Okta. The platform enables sellers to optimize product listings and manage their supply chain through integrated business tools.

## Key Topics

- Seller Platform
- Vendor Program
- Home Goods Marketplace
- Merchant Onboarding
- Product Optimization
- Furniture Marketplace
- Admin Portal
- Okta Authentication
- Supply Chain Management
- Seller Guide
- Shop Sustainably
- CastleGate
- Browser Cookies
- System Requirements
- Sign-In Portal

## Seller Platform & Vendor Program

- [Sell with Wayfair](https://sell.wayfair.com/): Wayfair vendor platform for home goods merchants to start selling
- [Optimize Products](https://sell.wayfair.com/start-optimize-products): Seller guide for product optimization and content strategy on Wayfair

## Administration & Access

- [Wayfair Production - Sign In](https://admin.wayfair.com/): Wayfair admin login portal with Okta authentication integration
